about: The Skerry of the Drowned and its causeway (Book 4 section 02; Book 9 sections 03 and 05; Stage 14, decisions S14-1, S14-3, S14-5 and S14-38): blocks 36 to 47 by 18 to 31, the east shore below Seal Cave, expanded by src/tools/levels/zones.ts. Grass runs down to a rocky coast with two fishing rocks; a beach and flats at its south-west corner; the causeway of weed-covered boulders (`=`, open only on spring-tide days inside the tidal ground window) from block (38, 25) out to the skerry, a low black rock at blocks (41 to 43, 28 to 29) whose crown is wet rock (`n`, reached only by the causeway, so open with it). Edit this plan, not the generated map, then run npm run zones.
